Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 3

“That same ancient yoga is declared by me to you today, for you are my devotee and my friend — and this is the supreme secret.”

Friend does the work in this verse. Krishna explains his willingness to speak not by Arjuna's qualifications but by their relationship, which is the chapter's quiet foundation.
